headline: Lamar Jackson left stadium in a boot, believed to be day-to-day with ankle injury
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson's day came to an early end due to an ankle injury, but signs continue to show that Jackson avoided any serious damage.

headline: Packers fear LB Edgerrin Cooper tore his Achilles
summary: The Packers expect to play the rest of the season without star linebacker Edgerrin Cooper.

headline: Rams rally behind Stafford, Williams from 10 points down in 4th quarter to beat Eagles 24-20
summary: — Kyren Williams ran for two touchdowns in the final four minutes as Matthew Stafford and the Los Angeles Rams rallied from a 10-point deficit to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 24-20 on Sunday.

headline: CeeDee Lamb’s late TD caps a wild Cowboys rally to beat winless Texans 34-30
summary: — CeeDee Lamb had a career-high 17 catches for 189 yards and his 12-yard TD reception with 40 seconds left lifted the Dallas Cowboys to a 34-30 win over Houston on Sunday to keep the Texans winless.

headline: Winston throws 3 TD passes and Banks' pick-6 seals Giants' 36-24 win over Cardinals
summary: — Jameis Winston showed off the good, bad and ugly of his football career and it required another late defensive stand to get it done. It was far from a masterpiece, but the New York Giants will take it.

headline: Trevor Lawrence finally gets 1st win over Bengals as Jaguars hold on for 22-17 victory
summary: — Trevor Lawrence passed for 227 yards and a touchdown, Jacksonville's defense forced two critical turnovers and the Jaguars held off the Cincinnati Bengals 22-17 on Sunday.
